about: Weights and gates for scripts/eval-agent.ts — definitions in docs/METRICS.md. Weights follow the ISO 25040-style split: functional suitability 50 (F0.5 25, DDP 15, mutation 10), reliability 25 (pass^k 15, 1 - flaky 10), performance 15 (time p90 10, cost 5), delivery 10 (DORA). The precision gate judges precision_real (known bugs vs false alarms); planted catches are left out of it.
